about_section.title: About FamilieHjælp
about_section.description: Familiehjælp is dedicated to making a difference for families in need. We understand the challenges that many families face, and we are here to provide support and resources that can help them navigate through difficult times. Our platform is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, so everyone can find the help they need when they need it.

helpingResources.headline: Our Helping Resources
helpingResources.description: At ForældreHjælp, we provide access to a range of resources that are shortcuts to quick help and support for parents in difficult situations. Our helping resources are designed to make it easy for you to find the support you need when you need it most. Whether you are looking for information, professional guidance, or a community of like-minded individuals, our platform is here to help you through your challenges as a parent. We understand the importance of having quick access to reliable resources, especially in difficult times, and our goal is to make this access as simple and effective as possible.

list_resources.title: Which helping resources do we offer
list_resources.description: We provide access to a range of helping resources that are shortcuts to quick help and support for parents in difficult situations. Some of the helping resources we offer include:

0.title: Resource Library
0.description: A comprehensive library of articles, guides, and videos covering a wide range of topics related to parenting, abortion, and stillbirth.

1.title: Professional Guidance
1.description: The ability to contact our team of experts for personalized advice and support, whether through chat, email, or phone.

2.title: Community Forum
2.description: A safe and supportive online forum where parents can share their experiences, ask questions, and find support from others who have been through similar situations.

3.title: Regular Updates
3.description: We continuously update our resources and add new ones based on feedback from our users and the latest research in parenting and related topics.
